          MODAL_API_KEY: ${{ env.MODAL_API_KEY }}

  deploy-railway:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RAILWAY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
    if: ${{ env.RAILWAY_TOKEN != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Railway CLI
        run: npm install -g railway

      - name: Login to Railway
        run: railway login --token ${{ env.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}

      - name: Initialize Railway project
        run: railway init

      - name: Deploy to Railway
        run: railway up

  deploy-fly:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
    if: ${{ env.FLY_API_TOKEN != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Flyctl
        run: npm install -g flyctl

      - name: Login to Fly.io
        run: flyctl auth login --access-token ${{ env.FLY_API_TOKEN }}

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        run: bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh

  deploy-daytona:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DAYTONA_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DAYTONA_TOKEN }}
    if: ${{ env.DAYTONA_TOKEN != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Daytona CLI
        run: npm install -g daytona

      - name: Login to Daytona
        run: daytona login --token ${{ env.DAYTONA_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Daytona environment
        run: daytona create

  verify-health:
    needs: [deploy-modal, deploy-railway, deploy-fly, deploy-daytona]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ always() }}
    steps:
